Python with class and functions, verify symbol count

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	tspack "github.com/xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack/packages/go/v2"
)

func main() {
	config := tspack.ProcessConfig{
		Language: `python`,
		Symbols:  true,
	}
	result, err := tspack.Process(`MY_CONST = 42
def helper(): pass
class Widget: pass
`, config)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Language)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Symbols)
}
```
